buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) Nagar Panchayat Rupauli, District Purnia, Bihar Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Children's Play Equipment (Multi-level Play Station, See-saw and Swing) 1. EXPERIENCE: The Bidder or the OEM of the offered product shall have the experience and past performance selected in the bid, in supply of same or similar products (outdoor children's play equipment such as multi-play stations, slides, swings and see-saws, including installation). Copies of work orders or contracts with invoices or completion certificates shall be submitted as proof. 2. BIDDER DOCUMENTS: The Bidder shall upload self-attested copies of (a) PAN; (b) GST Registration Certificate with the GST return of the last quarter or last month, whichever is latest; (c) Certificate of Incorporation or Firm Registration Certificate or Partnership Deed, as applicable; (d) Income Tax Returns of the last three assessment years; and (e) Power of Attorney or Board Resolution or authorisation in favour of the person signing the bid. 3. NON-BLACKLISTING AFFIDAVIT: The Bidder shall submit a notarised affidavit on Non-Judicial Stamp Paper of Rs.1000 declaring that the Bidder has not been blacklisted, debarred or banned by any Central or State Government Department, PSU, Urban Local Body or GeM. The affidavit shall be executed on or after the Bid

Published Date and before the Bid End Date, and shall mention the Bid Number. 4. AVERAGE ANNUAL TURNOVER: The Bidder shall have the minimum average annual turnover specified in the bid (50 percent of the estimated bid value) for the last three financial years. It shall be supported by audited Balance Sheets and Profit and Loss Accounts of the said years and a Chartered Accountant or Cost Accountant certificate on letterhead with a valid UDIN. The Buyer may verify the UDIN. 5. BANK SOLVENCY: The Bidder shall submit a Solvency Certificate from a Scheduled not earlier than six months before the Bid Published Date. 6. OEM AUTHORISATION: Where the Bidder is not the OEM, a valid OEM Authorisation Certificate specific to this bid shall be submitted, with an undertaking of backto- back warranty and supply of spare parts. The OEM and the Bidder shall be jointly and severally responsible for supply, installation and warranty. 7. MAKE IN INDIA: The Bidder shall upload the self-declaration of local content and place of value addition as per the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order, 2017 as amended. Purchase preference shall be as configured in this bid. 8. SERVICE SUPPORT IN BIHAR: The successful Bidder shall establish or nominate a service point in Bihar within 30 days of award and maintain it throughout the warranty period. The Bidder shall upload an undertaking to this effect with the bid. Preference to eligible bidders of Bihar shall be as per the Bihar Purchase Preference Policy, 2024. 9. WARRANTY AND SPARES: The Bidder shall upload an undertaking for warranty as per the technical specification, including civil works, and for availability of genuine spare parts for not less than 7 years from commissioning. 10. SITE INSPECTION: Bidders may visit the sites before quoting, at their own cost. No claim shall be entertained later on the ground of lack of knowledge of site conditions. 11. REPLACEMENT OF DAMAGED MATERIAL: Any supplied item found damaged, defective or not conforming to the approved specification at delivery or installation shall be replaced within 7 days of intimation, at no additional cost to the Department. 12. EARNEST MONEY DEPOSIT (EMD): EMD is a mandatory criterion of this bid. All other matters relating to EMD shall be dealt with in accordance with the GFR. 13. PERFORMANCE SECURITY: The successful Bidder shall furnish ePBG as specified in the bid, valid for 2 months beyond the warranty period. 14. QUALITY CERTIFICATION: The Bidder or the OEM of the offered product shall possess a valid ISO 9001:2015 certificate, issued on or before the Bid Published

15. SHORTFALL DOCUMENTS: Shortfall documents may be sought only for historical documents which existed on the Bid Opening Date, have not changed thereafter, and give no undue advantage to any bidder, through the GeM portal. 16. MANDATORY DOCUMENTS: All documents, certificates, affidavits and undertakings sought in the bid, this ATC and corrigenda, if any, shall be uploaded. Failure to submit any of them may lead to rejection of the bid, subject to GeM provisions on shortfall documents. 17. SERVICE SUPPORT: The Bidder or OEM shall provide a dedicated toll-free or mobile number, email ID and service contact person for complaints during the warranty period. 18. COMPLIANCE WITH TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION: All goods and works shall strictly comply with the uploaded Technical Specification (Ref. No. 1008 dated 31.10.2026), Annexures A, B and C and applicable standards. Bidders shall upload the filled and signed Annexure A with the bid. . 3.
